abEvolution.bChangesA: Threat type shifts to focus on environmental hazards and dynamic terrain responses
abEvolution.lateGameChange: Terrain adaptation becomes the dominant factor in decision-making

materialFusion.contrast: Adaptive build systems vs. environment-based threats

cThemes.name: Adaptive Build Systems
cThemes.gameplayEffect: Player's ability to dynamically adjust their survival strategy

delveDiscoveries.clue: The game begins with a simple fight but evolves into an intricate system of environmental interaction.
delveDiscoveries.discovery: Players learn to manage resources and adapt to changing threats through dynamic terrain adjustments.
delveDiscoveries.newChoice: Players choose between different build compositions that prioritize either resource efficiency or strategic flexibility.

delveDiscoveries.clue: Environmental hazards force players to re-evaluate their tactics.
delveDiscoveries.discovery: New enemy behaviors emerge based on terrain changes and weather patterns.
delveDiscoveries.newChoice: Players select between different threat types that challenge their current survival strategy.

delveDiscoveries.clue: Dynamic terrain adaptation alters all subsequent decisions.
delveDiscoveries.discovery: Players gain access to new environments and encounter unique challenges.
delveDiscoveries.newChoice: Players choose between different terrain adaptations that affect their entire playstyle.

delveDiscoveries.clue: The game's core mechanic is the continuous evolution of the player's strategy.
delveDiscoveries.discovery: Every choice leads to new possibilities for future actions.
delveDiscoveries.newChoice: Players can choose between multiple build compositions that evolve in response to environmental changes.

creativeGrammar.delveGrowthRule: Each discovery introduces a new gameplay layer; each growth rule modifies existing mechanics to reflect evolving strategies.
creativeGrammar.finalGameIdentity: A fusion of adaptive survival strategy and environment-based combat, where every decision influences the next phase of the game.
